title: MENU: buttons instead of a list
question: Does the menu now read as a menu of clickable buttons, not a list of information?
context_md: Round 30 shipped every lab page and toggle as one clickable list (Body::Choice), but Choice drew pixel-identical to an information row (Body::Value), so the tap target was invisible -- the owner's complaint. This gives Choice the bar button's own face+edge chrome (idle/hover/pressed), which fixes every page that uses it, not just MENU (also seen on ANTS' ANIMAL COLOUR/LIFE MARKS rows and BOX's RAIN/EVENTS rows in the same PR). Then splits MENU into two columns (PAGES / VIEW / TOGGLES -- the font has no '&' glyph, caught by rendering it), which buys back the section headings round 30 cut for a 1px pixel-budget overflow. Panel size: 152x231px (1 column) -> 286x139px (2 columns), both comfortably inside the screen. Blind.
